title: One-Two Punch
description: Your next Attack is played an extra time this turn.
smart_description: Your next [Amount] Attacks are played an extra time this turn.
notes: Counter-type power that decrements by 1 each time an Attack is played. At 1 stack, displays 'Your next Attack is played an extra time this turn.' At 2+ stacks, displays the plural form with the current stack amount shown. Automatically removed at the end of the player's turn.
